sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Ready to land is a placeholder. internal/tui/overview.go:221-222 says the list "comes with slice S09". Decision 49 (list-and-detect) puts a ready-to-land list with the `slicer land` command in v1. After a merge, render files can be stale (R8), so the view should show the `slicer render` command. `slicer land` needs --note (`slicer land --help`), which docs/dashboard.md:103 omits.
Decided: record 128 (landing.merge-detect): S63 supplies the merged flag on a HEAD change. S09 shows `slicer land` for a merged branch and `merge first` (no land command) for an unmerged one; until S63 lands it shows `merge state unknown`.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- internal/tui/overview.go:221-222: replace the placeholder with the list. Reuse the section helper already used for Needs you and Running (overview.go, the section calls before :221).
- internal/source/source.go:154-165 (EngineRun): add Branch (proposed; runrec.Record.Branch). EngineRun has no branch today.
- internal/daemon/runs.go:458 (EngineRun builder): set Branch.
- internal/tui/tui_test.go:1324-1330 (TestReadyToLandSaysItWaitsForS09): rewrite. It asserts the S09 placeholder.
- internal/tui/landing_test.go (new): the list tests.
- testdata/golden/: 44 files contain the placeholder (rg -l "comes with slice S0" testdata/golden). They are regenerated with -update.
- docs/dashboard.md:102-104: add --note to the command and state the render hint.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestReadyToLandListsCommittedRuns: a committed engine run appears with its item, its branch and the command `slicer land ITEM --branch BRANCH --note NOTE`.
- TestReadyToLandShowsOnlyCommittedRuns: stopped, paused and awaiting-approval runs do not appear.
- TestReadyToLandEmptyReadsNone: with no committed runs the section says none.
- TestReadyToLandShowsSliceRenderAfterAMerge: a branch known to be merged shows `slicer render` (needs the merge flag from S63; see Implement.md).
- TestReadyToLandPlaceholderIsGone: replaces TestReadyToLandSaysItWaitsForS09 (internal/tui/tui_test.go:1324); no "comes with slice S09" text remains.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests first: rewrite internal/tui/tui_test.go:1324-1330 and add internal/tui/landing_test.go (new).
2. internal/source/source.go:154-165: add Branch to EngineRun (proposed wire field, json "branch,omitempty"). internal/daemon/runs.go:458 sets it from the run record.
3. internal/tui/overview.go:221-222: replace the placeholder line with the list. For each EngineRun with State "committed" across projects, show one row with the item, the branch and a copyable command: slicer land ITEM --branch BRANCH --note "NOTE".
4. Empty state: "none".
5. Reuse the section helper that overview.go already uses for Needs you and Running.
6. The render hint: show `slicer render` only once a merge is known (the S63 flag). Before that, do not show it.
7. docs/dashboard.md:102-104: show --note in the command, and state the render hint.
8. Regenerate goldens: go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the diff in testdata/golden/ (44 files).
9. Check that TestACutOverviewSaysHowMuchIsMissing (tui_test.go:1387) still passes at the cut sizes.
Decided: record 128 (the merge flag comes from S63; show 'merge state unknown' until it lands).
Open:
- The default text for --note (slicer land: one line recorded in history, as for done).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui ./internal/source ./internal/daemon
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .   (expect no output)
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the diff in testdata/golden/ (the placeholder lines go; nothing else should change)
- rg -n "comes with slice S0" internal testdata   (expect no matches)
- slicer check
- adj lint
- Check the goldens at 80x24 and 100x30, colour and mono.
